description: Implementation of a cryptographic buffer pool with functions for creating, managing, and freeing buffer objects, including static and dynamic data handling, reference counting, and pool management.

methods.name: CRYPTO_BUFFER_POOL_new
methods.description: Creates a new buffer pool, initializes mutex, and generates a random hash key.

methods.name: CRYPTO_BUFFER_POOL_free
methods.description: Frees the buffer pool, ensuring all buffers are released and mutex is cleaned up.

methods.name: CRYPTO_BUFFER_new
methods.description: Creates a new buffer object with provided data, static or dynamic, and associates it with a pool.

methods.name: CRYPTO_BUFFER_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a buffer with specified length and returns a pointer to its data.

methods.name: CRYPTO_BUFFER_new_from_CBS
methods.description: Creates a buffer from a CBS (Crypto ByteString) object.

methods.name: CRYPTO_BUFFER_new_from_static_data_unsafe
methods.description: Creates a buffer from static data without copying, unsafe if data is modified.

methods.name: CRYPTO_BUFFER_free
methods.description: Decrements reference count and frees buffer if no longer referenced, handling static and pooled buffers.

methods.name: CRYPTO_BUFFER_up_ref
methods.description: Increments the reference count of a buffer.

methods.name: CRYPTO_BUFFER_data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the buffer's data.

methods.name: CRYPTO_BUFFER_len
methods.description: Returns the length of the buffer.

methods.name: CRYPTO_BUFFER_init_CBS
methods.description: Initializes a CBS with the buffer's data and length.
